text:
maria: Quick Q3 recurring-incident themes recap — wanted to surface top causes we've seen across postmortems and propose concrete owners/timelines. Thread to capture action items.

sam: nice, can you drop counts?

maria: sure — Q3 summary: 18 Sev2/Sev3 incidents total; 11 distinct postmortems. Of those, 9 map to recurring patterns (some overlap):
- Autoscaler misconfiguration / cold-start storms: 5 incidents
- Runtime memory leaks / OOMs on GPU nodes: 4 incidents
- Cache/KV eviction thrash causing repeated slow tails: 3 incidents
- Stale model roll / bad rollout fallback: 2 incidents
- Inter-region network flaps affecting fallback routing: 2 incidents

lee: that aligns with what I saw in tracing — p95 spikes usually during batch ramp. autoscaler config + sudden traffic patterns.

tanvi: suggested remediation bundles:
- Autoscale & burst policies: add cooldowns + circuit breaker on scale-up bursts (owner: joel, ETA: 2026-04-18)
- Runtime mem leaks: add OOM guardrails + nightly mem profilers + terminate/replace nodes that exceed mem thresholds (owner: sam, ETA: 2026-05-01)
- Cache stability: add KV-layer metrics and LRU tuning + increase cache headroom (owner: lee, ETA: 2026-04-30)
- Rollout safety: pin model variants + require canary pass + automatic rollback on quality regressions (owner: maria, ETA: 2026-04-25)
- Network resilience: add region health scoring & prefer-local routing with fallback limits (owner: ops_lead, ETA: 2026-05-10)

joel: acked. I'll also add a small canary ramp template and a `scale-rise` circuit breaker to the infra repo. Will open PRs by end of next week.

sam: for the memory leaks — I propose adding a nightly job that runs `gpu-mem-scan` across warm pools and posts diffs to the team channel. If a pool grows >10% over baseline we auto-quarantine.

lee: for cache thrash, I have an experiment: adjust `kv.cache.eviction_fraction` from 0.2 -> 0.35 on test clusters and run load for 48h, then compare p99. I'll own the experiment and report back.

maria: linking the two relevant postmortems: https://redwood.internal/pm/1745001110-gpu-oom and https://redwood.internal/pm/1759002220-autoscaler-storm — folks should add notes if they disagree with categorization.

ops_lead: please add these action items to the recurring-ops board and set reminders. I want monthly checkpoints until July.

maria: done — added cards and put owners/tags. Also scheduling a 30m follow-up review: 2026-04-20 10:00 PDT.

oncall-bot: Reminder — new runbook entries required for `autoscale-burst` and `model-roll-safety`. Please update within 2 weeks.

sam: +1 on runbooks. Also requesting a small alert tuning change: current alert fires at 0.2% error rate for 2m; propose 0.5% for 5m for the specific backend path to reduce noise.

maria: noted. Action summary (short):
- Joel: scale/circuit breaker PR (ETA 2026-04-18)
- Sam: nightly mem-scan + OOM guard (ETA 2026-05-01)
- Lee: cache tuning experiment (ETA 2026-04-30)
- Maria: model pin + rollback policy (ETA 2026-04-25)
- Ops_lead: region routing polish (ETA 2026-05-10)
- All: update runbooks and mark postmortems with recurring-pattern tag

maria: tagging this thread as the canonical quarterly recurring-incident action list. Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept ownership or drop a note if you need different timelines.

joel: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup: will start mem-scan config today.

lee: :thumbsup: starting experiment tomorrow.

ops_lead: noted. I'll schedule checkpoints and add to oncall rotation docs.

maria: thanks everyone — closing thread for now, will post updates in the board and follow-up meeting notes.
